For p>=kappa, a direct near-ray deficit valid for every p>=1 replaces the p/2-specific spatial step, while convexity of sigma>=1 controls the vertical coordinate. The three local exclusion lemmas feed the standard homogeneous packing and greedy-coloring proof, with ball-volume exponent n+kappa. Endpoint p=kappa and the known kappa=2 and kappa=1 consistency checks agree with the theorem.

Exact and synonymous literature searches and the current SCOPE archive did not locate the arbitrary-kappa classification p>=kappa. Recency leaves residual risk of unindexed simultaneous work.
